params.name: page
params.description: Number of the requested page. Use this parameter to iterate through all items on the different pages. The total amount of pages is listed in the response body (pageAmount).

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Parameter for specifying the queried items per page.

params.name: q
params.description:
Filter parameter in {filter}:{value} format. Expects comma separated list of filtering criteria out of the following fields:
  • geofenceId
  • category
  • iccid
  • type
  • startDateTime (UTC)
  • endDateTime (UTC)

Example: "type:device,iccid:ICCID,startDateTime:2022-11-14T16:04:38.000Z"

items.docs: Get a list of the administration logs regarding the organization.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Specify the needed timezone as string parameter (e.g., Europe/Amsterdam) for the resulting query output.

params.name: category
params.description: Specify the category as string parameter for the resulting query output.

items.docs: Get the administration logs statistics for the current organization.

params.name: adminLogId
params.description: Unique Id of the administration log for which the payload should be queried.

items.docs: Get a URL pointing to a single administration log payload. The received URL will trigger a download.
